scenarios.title: Supplier payment in cash settles payables through the till
Supplier payment by bank: wallet bucket, bank account ref
Cheque payment settles the payable at issuance via cheques_issued
Expense paid in cash from the till
Expense correction is a mirror entry citing the original (F-5)
Cheque expense credits the cheques_issued bridge, no money account
Manual cash in books owner capital
Manual cash out books owner drawings
Transfer between buckets moves both GL accounts
Same-bucket transfer: two wallet lines, bucket total unmoved
Tax payment is capped at taxPosition.netPayable of the journal before it
Purchase return by payable offset: Dr payables / Cr inventory + tax_input; DN wraps it
Purchase return by cash refund: Dr cash / Cr inventory + tax_input
IN clearing: Dr deposit account bucket / Cr cheques_in_hand
IN bounce restores the receivable; charges are a separate entry; compensating credit row re-opens the khata
IN return (undeposited) mirrors capture and re-opens the khata
OUT clearing: Dr cheques_issued / Cr drawn-on account bucket
OUT bounce: Dr cheques_issued / Cr payables; reversal row nets supplierPaid
Cheque part debits cheques_in_hand inside the bill entry; registry doc is born received
Void hands a still-in-hand cheque back: Cr cheques_in_hand, registry closes returned
Cheque repayment settles the receivable now, value in cheques_in_hand
Credit note figures EQUAL the return engine's figures by construction
